limitations: These are cheap cold-start matched pilots, not comparisons against the completed eight-hour checkpoints.
Cross-seed stability and fitting the average-policy reference do not prove equilibrium strength.
Local response gains are measured per sampled decision, not bb per complete hand or full-game exploitability.
Reference sampling SE excludes neural approximation error; residual interval widths are not relabeled as SE.
No 50bb/100bb activation, trained-weight replacement, paid compute, or unconditional long-run extension.
